name: ljm-church-contributions
description: Light of Jesus Ministry — church contributions portal (static site + Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1). No build step; this file exists only to run the test suite.

scripts.db:local:setup: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npx wrangler d1 execute ljm-contributions-db --local --file=./schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute ljm-contributions-db --local --file=./migrations/0024_seed_prayer_programs.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute ljm-contributions-db --local --file=./migrations/0025_v2_launch_content_seed.sql
scripts.e2e:server: npm run db:local:setup && npx wrangler pages dev . --port 8788 --ip 127.0.0.1
